description: The industry of the spot usage. With usage it names a row of waybill_loads.csv, which hartlib.waybills checks.
The spot usage, as spot_assignments.csv's Usage names it.
supplier for a party that ships the inbound load, customer for one that takes the outbound load (customers also route the inbound empties of a load spot).
The party's number within the usage and role, 1 to n with no gaps. The deck draws parties in this order, so a seeded run prints the same cards.
The shipper or receiver as the card prints it.
The road a customer is reached by. Empty on suppliers.
The road a supplier's load enters by. Empty: the card says CSX.
The load this party's cards carry where it differs from the usage's load (the chemicals of a Process Chemicals spot, the steel of General Freight).
